set.body:
Plan: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: O03
Accountable role (person not assigned): Backend/operations engineer with institutional operator

Outcome: Catalog/blob loss cannot force recovery to trust stale permissions or credentials.

Acceptance:
- Design and implement an independently durable authority journal/checkpoint with sequence/completeness and authenticity verification, including memberships, stewardship and principal disablement; specify restrictive-change acknowledgment and replication-failure behavior.
- Schedule verified off-host catalog/blob backups and rehearse restore with the source database unavailable; reconcile current policy, invalidate old credentials/sessions/leases and remain closed when evidence is incomplete.
- Measure backup age/RPO and catalog/API versus full-blob-loss RTO; retain verifiable backup and recovery receipts. A digest or copy on the original host alone is insufficient.

Evidence anchors:
- modules/postgres/src/main/scala/sanctity/postgres/PostgresRecovery.scala
- scripts/backup-postgres.sh
- scripts/restore-postgres.sh

Status: planned; no implementation or qualification claimed.
set.title: O03: Preserve current authority independently and automate disaster recovery
